arStrings.szText: "Elder, Athrpa says you have had visions concerning Philios. We need to find his vault."
Elder? Athrpa is the old one! Oh, the mischiefs we had in our youth. Don’t tell me you are still obsessed with that one vision.
Light-hearted, then sobers and becomes more serious when talking about her friend's vision obsession.
All of my visions were chronicled. I did not see Philios himself, but I saw two children fleeing a father. By accident, they stumbled across an ancient place. The full vision lies over there.
